name: Financial Institution 8
definition: Information related to a financial institution required by business or regulation (for example, in money or funds transfer).

Email.name: Email
Email.definition: Electronic mail address of the financial institution.

URL.name: URL
URL.definition: Universal Resource Locator (URL) address of the financial institution.

Phone.name: Phone
Phone.definition: Collection of information that identifies a phone number, as defined by telecom services.

CustomerService.name: Customer Service
CustomerService.definition: Phone number of the customer services.

AdditionalContact.name: Additional Contact
AdditionalContact.definition: Additional information used to facilitate contact with the financial institution, for instance dispute manager name.

LocalData.name: Local Data
LocalData.definition: Contains text fields in the local language.
